The '''Ather system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ather]].
